pr_title: Fix InvariantGlobalization=false in a trimmed app
pr_body:
Move the LoadICU logic into a static ctor, so it runs early in the process, but not as part of querying the GlobalizationMode.Invariant property. This allows for LoadICU to still be invoked, even when the app is trimmed and GlobalizationMode.Invariant is hard-coded `false` by the linker.

While I was changing this code, I also removed the workaround in Browser builds for swallowing errors being returned from LoadICU.

Fix #49073
Fix #49391

issue_context.title: [wasm] GlobalizationMode.Invariant should not eat LoadICU errors on Browser
issue_context.body:
See the discussion in

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/49073#issuecomment-793547670
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/49073#issuecomment-793916722
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/49073#issuecomment-794271924

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/79ae74f5ca5c8a6fe3a48935e85bd7374959c570/src/libraries/System.Private.CoreLib/src/System/Globalization/GlobalizationMode.Unix.cs#L25-L37

On Browser, if `LoadICU()` fails, we should call `Environment.FailFast` just like any other platform. We shouldn't fallback to Invariant mode.

cc @lewing @EgorBo @tarekgh @safern
